headline: Brazilian Real Pressured as Foreign Investors Increase Dollar Futures Purchases
summary: Foreign investors increased long positions in US dollar futures contracts in Brazil, maintaining upward pressure on the dollar against the Brazilian real.
why: Foreign capital flows in futures contracts directly impact the Brazilian real's exchange rate and local inflation dynamics.

impacts.name: USD/BRL
impacts.why: Foreign demand for US dollar futures pushed the dollar exchange rate higher against the real.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Foreign institutional investors accelerated long dollar future positioning amid macroeconomic uncertainties.
